requirements.text: Open to Axis Bank and other-bank customers.

Kotak Mahindra Bank.summary: UPI payments in the Kotak Mobile Banking app.

slice Small Finance Bank.summary: UPI payments from slice and other-bank accounts.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Indian resident with an active account at an RBI-licensed bank and a slice profile.

requirements.label: PayZapp
requirements.text: Register your mobile number and verify the OTP. Non-HDFC customers need PAN-based KYC; HDFC account or card holders can use bank-based KYC.

ICICI Bank.summary: UPI payments through iMobile, including accounts from other banks.

requirements.label: iMobile
requirements.text: Sign in, create a UPI ID and link an ICICI or other-bank account.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: A smartphone, internet access and a bank account with your active mobile number registered.

Yes Bank.summary: Mobile and internet banking from YES BANK.

requirements.label: YES ONLINE
requirements.text: A YES BANK savings, current, loan or credit-card account, with a bank-registered mobile number for OTPs.

State Bank of India.summary: UPI payments through BHIM SBI Pay and YONO.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: BHIM SBI Pay accepts participating-bank accounts. Other-bank customers can also register for UPI through YONO.

Unity Small Finance Bank.summary: Personal and business banking from Unity.

India Post Payments Bank.summary: Mobile banking and BHIM UPI for IPPB accounts.

requirements.label: IPPB mobile banking
requirements.text: Use your registered mobile number, account number, customer ID and date of birth. Set security questions and an MPIN, then verify the OTP.

Airtel Payments Bank.summary: UPI payments from Airtel Payments Bank and other-bank accounts.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: A SIM and an account at a UPI-supporting bank. Use the same mobile number in the Airtel app and bank account.

Federal Bank.summary: Banking and UPI payments through FedMobile.

requirements.label: FedMobile
requirements.text: Other-bank customers can use the app with limited features. A Federal account gives access to all features.

Jio Payments Bank.summary: UPI through Jio Payments Bank and its partner apps.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Register and link an account at a bank in India. Bank and NPCI conditions apply.

requirements.label: NRI accounts
requirements.text: Deutsche Bank India NRO or NRE account, with a registered domestic or supported international mobile number.

Jammu & Kashmir Bank.summary: Mobile banking with UPI registration and payments.

requirements.label: Canara ai1Pe
requirements.text: Use the mobile number registered with your bank account. Other-bank customers can link participating-bank savings/current accounts or RuPay cards.

requirements.label: RBL MoBank
requirements.text: Other-bank customers can link participating-bank accounts for UPI. RBL banking features require an RBL customer account.

requirements.label: BHIM PNB
requirements.text: Register, link a participating-bank account and set a UPI PIN. A PNB account is not required.

IndusInd Bank.summary: UPI payments from accounts at participating banks.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Use the same mobile number in the app and linked bank account.

Indian Bank.summary: Retail banking and UPI payments through IndSMART.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: A smartphone, internet access, linked bank account and the mobile number registered with your bank.

requirements.label: Union ease
requirements.text: A Union Bank account is required to register. You can add accounts from other banks afterwards.

requirements.label: SIB Mirror+
requirements.text: Your current mobile number must be registered with the bank. Eligible sole account holders can activate with SIB debit-card details.

Standard Chartered.summary: UPI payments and collections from Standard Chartered.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Accounts from other banks can be linked. Businesses arrange collection services through a relationship manager or UPI support.

UCO Bank.summary: UPI payments through BHIM UCO UPI.

requirements.label: BHIM UCO UPI
requirements.text: Install the app, select your bank and account, create a UPI ID and link the account. Open to any bank’s customers.

Fino Payments Bank.summary: FinoPay supports UPI, linked bank accounts and RuPay credit cards.

requirements.label: Cent PAY
requirements.text: Register for UPI and link your bank account. You do not need to be a Central Bank customer.

DBS digibank.summary: UPI payments through digibank, including non-DBS accounts.

requirements.label: digibank UPI
requirements.text: Select your bank, choose an account linked to your mobile number and set a UPI ID.

Bank of India.summary: UPI payments through BOI BHIM UPI.

requirements.label: BOI BHIM UPI
requirements.text: Complete registration using the mobile number registered for the UPI service.

Karnataka Bank.summary: BHIM KBL UPI supports Karnataka Bank and other-bank accounts.

requirements.label: BHIM KBL UPI
requirements.text: A valid debit card and bank-registered mobile number with transaction SMS alerts. On dual-SIM phones, keep that SIM in the primary slot.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Use the mobile number registered for the UPI service.

NSDL Payments Bank.summary: UPI and bank-account linking through NSDL Jiffy.

Suryoday Small Finance Bank.summary: BHIM Suryoday UPI includes UPI Lite.

Bank of Maharashtra.summary: UPI payments from Bank of Maharashtra.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: The bank’s instructions use Maha Mobile Plus and your bank-registered mobile number.

notes: The bank also offers Zen Lyfe; confirm which app to use.

Equitas Small Finance Bank.summary: UPI payments for Equitas and other-bank customers.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Complete one-time registration to pay from your linked bank account.

requirements.label: TMB MBank
requirements.text: Verify the device with your registered mobile number and set an MPIN or login PIN.

Indian Overseas Bank.summary: UPI payments through BHIM IOB UPI.

requirements.label: BHIM IOB UPI
requirements.text: Register and set a PIN using debit-card or Aadhaar details. Accounts from other banks can also be linked.

Punjab & Sind Bank.summary: Punjab & Sind Bank’s UPI app supports multiple bank accounts.

PhonePe.summary: UPI transfers and payments to people and shops.

requirements.label: Age
requirements.text: 18+. You must be legally able to enter an agreement.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: A PhonePe account and your own bank or payment account linked to an active mobile number. Supported overseas numbers are available for NRI accounts.

Google Pay.summary: UPI transfers, shopping payments, recharges and bills.

requirements.label: Age
requirements.text: 13+. Under 18s need permission from a parent or legal guardian. Teen accounts require Indian residence and a +91 number.

requirements.label: Bank account
requirements.text: Use the mobile number linked to your bank account. Verify with debit-card details or Aadhaar.

requirements.label: Age
requirements.text: 18+. You must be legally able to enter an agreement. Additional rules apply to individual services.

notes: Full UPI joining requirements not confirmed.

super.money.summary: UPI cashback and credit cards issued by partner banks.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Use a bank account you are authorised to operate, with your mobile number kept up to date.

requirements.label: Secured cards
requirements.text: The Utkarsh and Kotak card products require a fixed deposit. This is separate from UPI.

notes: Minors need parental permission and supervision; the terms require a parent or guardian to make their transactions. Full card-approval rules not confirmed.

BHIM.summary: Bank-account payments and transfers over UPI.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: A smartphone, bank account and bank-registered mobile number. The FAQ describes PIN setup using debit-card details.

FamApp by Trio.summary: UPI and card payments using a linked bank account or FamX wallet.
notes: Current age, KYC and guardian-consent requirements not confirmed.

requirements.label: WhatsApp Pay
requirements.text: 18+, an Indian phone number and your own account at a UPI-supporting bank. Use the same number for WhatsApp and the bank account.

CRED.summary: Credit-card bills, card management and rewards.

requirements.label: Membership
requirements.text: 21+ for new members joining from 1 October 2023; earlier members had to be 18+ when joining. You must allow access to your credit information. CRED sets service-specific score thresholds.

requirements.label: IndusInd RuPay card
requirements.text: 18+, Indian resident and an existing CRED user. Approval depends on the bank’s credit checks.

notes: Card eligibility is separate from membership. A fixed score threshold for every service is not confirmed.

Amazon Pay.summary: Shopping payments, bills, a wallet and bank-linked UPI inside Amazon.

requirements.label: UPI
requirements.text: Link your bank account through the Amazon app.

notes: Minimum age and full joining requirements not confirmed.

MobiKwik.summary: UPI payments and a prepaid wallet.

requirements.label: Wallet
requirements.text: 18+. Identity documents are collected for verification.
